stem:
The graph compares Maths and Science quiz marks for Ishaan, Rekha, and Tushar with adjacent bars, one common scale, and a legend.

Which claim correctly describes how the graph is built?

options.text: For each student, two adjacent bars share the category, use the same vertical scale, and the legend separates Maths from Science.
The display is finished by naming it a double column graph, without comparing any bar heights.
Drawing the clustered bars is what creates the Maths and Science quiz marks.
Only the tallest bar matters, because it is the most obvious height on the graph.

teacher.key_rationale: A clustered column graph places related bars side by side for each category, keeps one common scale, and uses a legend so the datasets can be compared.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source pie chart as a clustered double-column graph with legend and common scale.
